domains.application_implementation: Independent project/media bundle. Frozen CPR profiles V1/V2/V3/V4 retain their interpretations. Explicit source-event research rendering replays frozen CPR provenance and reconstructs one supported zero-origin event from user-selected matching mono/stereo PCM24 WAV, at the original rate, to Float32 WAV with a separate event-gain multiply. Project mixer, routing, effects and automation are bypassed. The unresolved event and frozen profiles remain unchanged; ordinary project playback, mixdown and exchange retain their barriers. A bounded unit-agnostic reconstruction of native segment selection retains generation/successor behavior and inclusive endpoint comparison. Source audition supplies a separately justified zero-origin source descriptor; it does not infer arbitrary native builder units. Application scheduling uses its own half-open sample intervals and nearest-frame, ties-away-from-zero quantization. Device scheduling, unity routing and completion via AVAudioPlayerNode dataPlayedBack callbacks are application implementation, not measured Cubase host behavior.
